name: Infection Analyse Results - Part 5
content: Testing is over and the results are conclusive: every subject treated with the vaccine has become permanently immune to the infection. For the record, the final formula is an honey bottle to contain the pathogen, some blue plasma to carry it, a lunar parasite tooth for the active agent, and a lunar crawler spike cluster to stabilise the mixture. Our work here is done. We are filing the complete procedure so that anyone who finds these records can produce the vaccine themselves and protect themselves about the infection.
